_about: What the import check (tools/assets/asset_check.gd, tests/unit/tools/asset_import_test.gd) asks of every committed art asset under assets/. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §11 explains each field; the art repo's docs/contract.md and docs/godot.md are the source.

texture_compress_mode._about: compress/mode of a texture's .import per folder: 2 VRAM Compressed (3D), 0 Lossless (UI).

texture_compress_exceptions._about: An image whose compress/mode differs from its folder's, by its path (#1690): data a shader reads, not colour, that VRAM compression would spoil. The art package's HANDOFF.md names each.

body._about: A GLB under assets/body/<id>/ (a first-person viewmodel, #1587), its row keyed by <id>: the clips the game plays (their art names as Godot 4.7.2 imports them, a _Loop suffix dropped and looping) and the nodes it hangs things on. The art package's HANDOFF.md is the source.

character._about: A GLB under assets/characters/. The bones are the art export's rig as measured (art docs/animations.md: CharacterArmature, 62 Ultimate Modular bones plus Toe.L and Toe.R); the contract v2 may replace them. The clips are the art MVP set's names (art tools/blender/anim_sets/mvp.toml) as Godot 4.7.2 imports them (a _Loop suffix dropped, the clip looping): the clips the avatar maps (client/player/avatar_clips.gd, #522; the knockdown is a ragdoll, art #115, so Knockdown, Crawl and Getup_Fours went); the GLB carries more (jump, turn, raise, talk, push, knife), unchecked until a mapping uses them.

params._about: animation/fps is the rate the GLB was baked at, which its .export.json records (art docs/godot.md): 30 for an animation set such as the MVP set (mvp.toml fps = 30). A character baked at another rate (the alien, 24 fps) sets it in its own row under rows.

player_options._about: The importer's options on the AnimationPlayer node (_subresources nodes PATH:AnimationPlayer).

rows._about: A character whose package differs from the shared row above (#1690), keyed by assets/characters/<id>/: its own params, player_options, bones and clips replace the shared ones. The art package's HANDOFF.md and package.json are the source.

params._about: The alien's GLB is baked at 24 fps (its HANDOFF, art#398) and imported at 0.94 of its size, applied to its meshes, skeleton and clips: its eyes at the game's 1.6 m (CharacterProfile.ALIEN_SCALE, #1693).
